character: Main Jura ski village on the Swiss border. 35km downhill, 100km+ cross-country. Cross-country paradise. Forested, peaceful, family-friendly. Access to Swiss ski areas nearby.

non_ski_activities.nordic: 100km+ cross-country trails. Jura Nordic area. Classic and skate skiing.
non_ski_activities.other: Snowshoeing, sledging, winter hiking, Swiss border location, Lac des Rousses.
